name: @sos-2/live-store
description: SOS 2.0 Live Store (Work Order P2): durable, provider-neutral repositories for the live product state — Mission, Context, SystemState, Evidence, Architecture, Candidate, Assurance, Experiment, Decision, AuthorityGrant, Package, history (ArchitectureMemory/CausalHypothesis), development state, task state (the §6 task-durability shape), body lease state and observation events — plus the provider PORTS for the free-tier reference stack: PostgresStoreAdapter (Neon target: durable canonical state), RedisCoordinationAdapter (Upstash target: cache/leases/idempotency ONLY — NEVER canonical) and ObjectStoreAdapter (Cloudflare R2 target: large immutable artifacts by content hash). A complete in-memory reference implementation is included; real provider SDKs attach in later waves as optional peers WITHOUT contract change. Domain record shapes are STORED AND RETURNED VERBATIM, validated by the owning packages' own guards (consumed — never redefined); the Semantic Spine remains the only identity/serialization authority; semantic IDs and exact revisions are preserved, never re-minted, never rewritten.
